integrity: The general statement is proved symbolically. The packaged enumeration stress-tests finite boundary cases and is not used as an extrapolative proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns unbased homotopy classes between crown finite spaces and does not compute the internal homotopy type of each mapping-poset component.
The close graph-homomorphism analogue is an explicit residual originality risk; order-preserving crown maps additionally allow collapsed comparable pairs.
Finite exhaustive computations are supplementary checks only; the general theorem rests on the symbolic lift and local-homotopy argument.
title: Divisibility controls homotopy classes between finite crown circle models
